detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
JOIN (
  SELECT ip_address, COUNT(*) as failed_attempts 
  FROM login_events 
  WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') 
  AND UPPER(status) LIKE '%FAILED%' 
  GROUP BY ip_address 
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
) failed_ips ON le.ip_address = failed_ips.ip_address 
JOIN (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT country) as countries 
  FROM transactions 
  WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-2 hours') 
  GROUP BY user_id
) countries ON u.user_id = countries.user_id 
WHERE u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') 
AND u.user_id NOT IN (
  SELECT user_id 
  FROM login_events 
  WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-2 hours') 
  AND ip_address = failed_ips.ip_address
)
detections.recommendation: Try broadening your search criteria or checking if the data for this period is available.

detections.sql:
SELECT 
  le.country, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) as active_users, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) as failed_transactions, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.status) as failure_rate
FROM 
  users u 
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
  JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE 
  u.account_status = 'ACTIVE' 
  AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')
GROUP BY 
  le.country
HAVING 
  failure_rate > 0.1
ORDER BY 
  failure_rate DESC;

SELECT 
  u.user_id, 
  u.full_name, 
  t.instrument, 
  SUM(t.amount_usd) as total_usd, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.instrument) as num_instruments, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.instrument IN (SELECT instrument FROM transactions WHERE user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY instrument HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) THEN t.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) as high_volume_usd
FROM 
  users u 
  JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')
GROUP BY 
  u.user_id, u.full_name, t.instrument
HAVING 
  high_volume_usd > 0.2 * SUM(t.amount_usd)
ORDER BY 
  u.user_id;

  u.full_name, 
  u.risk_level, 
  t.instrument, 
  t.amount_usd, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.instrument = u.instrument THEN t.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.amount_usd) AS instrument_ratio
FROM 
  users u 
  JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id

  u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH')
